libraries: React 18/19, Tailwind CSS v3/v4, Lucide React, Radix UI Primitives / Shadcn UI, TanStack Query
guidelines: Use functional components with explicit props interfaces. Encapsulate state with custom hooks. Prefer composition over prop drilling.

libraries: Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Next-Themes, Lucide React
guidelines: Leverage React Server Components (RSC) for initial page renders and SEO. Mark interactive client widgets with 'use client'. Use Next Image with blur placeholders.

libraries: Vue 3, Script Setup (Composition API), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Vue, Radix Vue / Shadcn-Vue, Pinia
guidelines: Use <script setup lang='ts'>. Leverage defineProps and defineEmits. Group state logically inside Pinia stores.

libraries: Tailwind CSS, clsx, tailwind-merge (cn helper), tailwindcss-animate
guidelines: Never write inline style objects when Tailwind classes are available. Use the cn() helper to merge conditional classes cleanly.

libraries: Shadcn UI, Radix UI Primitives, Lucide React, class-variance-authority (cva)
guidelines: Do not treat Shadcn as an external black-box npm package; customize component code directly in your components/ui folder to fit your DESIGN.md tokens.
